project: Slag is the workshop where the anneal and collet plugins were developed; it keeps the SDK eval runner and its own collet harness. Node 22 or later, no dependency installation or build step at the root.
conventions: Root JavaScript uses CommonJS; the .mjs files under scripts/sdk-eval and .collet are ESM.
Public records never name another project except where it was measured.
Tracked text writes zero-width, bidi, tag and stray variation-selector characters as escapes, never raw.
